title: Alchemy Security Manager is the enforcement point
summary: AlchemyPermissionPolicyAdapter implements the existing Alchemy Security Manager policy contract for METHOD checkpoints. The adapter decides; Security Manager remains the component that prevents execution.
invariants: The Access Permissions module does not replace or fork Alchemy Security Manager.
The adapter governs METHOD checkpoints and may delegate other checkpoint kinds to a fallback Security Manager policy.
A governed method must remain PROTECTED or implement an independent local gate, because policy cannot enforce a checkpoint the interpreter never emits.

provenance.claim: The adapter decides while Alchemy Security Manager remains the enforcement point; v0.3 separates live Permission policy changes from pinned Access Control policy identity.
AlchemyPermissionPolicyAdapter implements METHOD evaluation and returns AlchemySecurityDecision after live session, policy, Security Effect and Permission checks.
Security Manager can enforce only interpreter-emitted METHOD checkpoints; governed methods must remain PROTECTED or have a local gate.
